President Assents to Uniform Civil Code Laws in Gujarat and Assam

President Droupadi Murmu has given her assent to the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) laws passed in Gujarat and Assam. This development makes Gujarat the second state, following Uttarakhand, to implement UCC. The assent signifies the final approval for the legislation in both states.
